# Weekly Brief — Free Tier Sample

This is a sample article for testing the free-tier publishing path.

## Key Points

- Free articles get a random suffix on their slug
- Free articles show ads in the predefined slots
- Free articles are subject to traffic-based lifecycle evaluation

## Lifecycle Behavior

When this article is more than 30 days old and has fewer than 10 unique visitors
in the last 30 days, it will be marked **at risk** and a warning banner will appear.

The banner reads:
> "This post will expire in X days unless traffic increases or it is upgraded to paid."

After 7 days in the at-risk state, the article will be marked **expired** unless
traffic recovers.
